notes.title: Exciting News for Demonologist Fans: Night Club Simulator 🍸
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Demonologist Community[/h2]

We are thrilled to introduce a brand-new game developed by [b]our second team[/b], designed specifically for you and your friends to have an absolute blast together!

[h1][b]🔥 Introducing: Night Club Simulator! 🔥[/b][/h1]

In this game, [b]you and your friends[/b] will take on the challenge of transforming a rundown nightclub into the hottest venue in town. But it won’t be easy—you’ll have to manage chaos, deal with rowdy customers, craft unique cocktails, and unlock exciting new upgrades to create the ultimate nightlife experience.

[h2]🚀 Play the Free Demo on February 24th![/h2]
The game will have a [b]completely free demo[/b] available on [b]February 24th[/b], allowing you to experience the nightlife madness with your friends! Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist to stay updated on all the latest details.

[h2]🔔 Stay Connected on Discord![/h2]
We have also updated our Discord channels so you can stay informed about everything related to Night Club Simulator. Make sure to grab the [b]Night Club Simulator[/b] Role to receive all the latest news and announcements!

While our first team continues to work on Demonologist, our second team has been pouring their passion into this exciting new project. Rest assured, Demonologist will keep receiving updates and improvements, but we wanted to bring you something fresh and equally fun to enjoy.

We can't wait to share more details soon! Let us know what you think, and get ready for a wild ride in [b]Night Club Simulator![/b] 🍹🎶🔥

[h2][b]Wishlist NOW[/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943670/Night_Club_Simulator/

— Clock Wizard Games Team

notes.title: Demonologist Overhaul – Major Updates Incoming! 🎃🔧
notes.notes:
Hello Demonologist community,

We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, and today we’re excited to share some major updates regarding Demonologist’s future!

🔹 Full Graphical Overhaul – We’re completely revamping the visuals to bring a fresh, immersive experience. Expect improved lighting, textures, and an overall more atmospheric world.

🔹 VRAM & Performance Optimization – We’re focusing on optimizing memory usage and overall game performance, ensuring smoother gameplay for all players, regardless of hardware.

🔹 VIVOX & Speech Recognition Improvements – Our team is investigating deeper integrations and improvements to voice processing. While there are some technical limitations with current solutions, we are actively working on refining them for a better experience.

While there are still some minor challenges, rest assured that none of them are major roadblocks. Our top priority is to refine and optimize the game, making sure it runs flawlessly.

We’ll be sharing new visuals and updates soon! Thank you for your patience and support. We can’t wait for you to experience the improvements! 🖤👻

— Clock Wizard Games Team

notes.title: Demonologist v0.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thank you for your patience while we deal with the influx of bug reports!

And now... 0.3.0 PATCH NOTES
[list]
[*] New purchasable tool: "Fulu Talisman" can be found in the shop! 
[*] ESG has been boosted by 10% and now includes the following voice commands: "manifest" and "show yourself"
[*] Findable lore notes have been added.
[*] Flashlight toggling has been added (default key binding: F).
[*] Text-based voice command/speech recognition has been added (default key binding: P).
[*] Single player reward boost has been increased to 1.5x.
[*] New random objectives have been added.
[*] New character hairstyles and beards have been added.
[*] Added language support: Arabic, Croatian, Serbian, Spanish (Español)
[*] New Hidden Achievement added.
[/list]

[b]NOTE: YOU MAY NEED TO RESET YOUR KEYBINDS IN ORDER TO USE THE FLASHLIGHT AND SPEECH RECOGNITION KEYS
[/b]

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Blurring on TVs has been reduced.
[*] Altar collision issue in Abandoned House has been fixed.
[*] Clock setting issue (Rewind/Reverse time) in Cyclone St. has been fixed.
[*] An issue where the player can not move after dying on the clock in Cyclone St. has been fixed.
[*] Some crash issues have been fixed.
[*] Minor text fixes
[/list]


Bugs being addressed with 0.3.1
[list]
[*] Flashlight toggle SOUND from the keybind is only available for the host. Players connecting to the host will not hear the toggle sound when using the keybind, but will still be able to use the flashlight. 
[*] Character walks forward if moving while picking up the note. (You can resolve this by pressing your walk key after exiting the note, or not moving when picking up the note for now.)
[*] Language: Arabic and newly added languages added have display issues in the Lost Notes (Magna, Maria Victoria, etc.)
[/list]


As always, you will need to update your game and will not be able to connect to existing users' lobbies that have not updated yet!
